title: TasteEvent
description: One observed taste-relevant action. This is the event object shared by every burst5 FridgeLuck spec; the taste spec owns the kinds and payloads. Local storage is the taste_events table (docs/spec/taste/SPEC.md section 5).

id.description: UUID v4 string. Stable across retries; replaying an id is a no-op (idempotent ingest).

at.description: Event time, ISO-8601 UTC, millisecond precision.

kind.description: Event kind. The full catalogue with payloads and emitting surfaces is docs/spec/taste/SPEC.md section 7.

eater.description: Who the event is attributed to: 'you', a household eater id, or null when the app cannot attribute it (household event). Attribution is asked on feedback, never inferred.

recipe.description: RecipeRef, or null when the event does not concern a recipe (e.g. profile_edited on an ingredient feature).

ingredient.description: IngredientID: the app's Int64 ingredients.id, as a JSON integer, or null.

surface.description: The surface that emitted the event. Dotted, lowercase.

payload.description: Kind-specific payload. Every field is typed in the event catalogue; unknown fields are dropped on ingest, never interpreted.
